_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A New Beginning#003.src: To honor Her Majesty and to celebrate Her grace and blessings placed upon the land.
A New Beginning#003.dst: 女王陛下を称え、この地にもたらされた恵みと祝福を祝うために。

A New Beginning#004.src: You've gotten about as much worthwhile information out of this conversation as you'll get.
A New Beginning#004.dst: この会話から得られる有益な情報は、もうこれくらいだろう。

A New Beginning#005.src: E's real! Real I tells ya! Saw 'im with my own two eyes I did!
A New Beginning#005.dst: 奴は本物だ！本物だって！この目でしっかり見たんだ！

A New Beginning#006.src: But enough of that. You want to go to {p}, right?
A New Beginning#006.dst: だが、その話はもういい。{p} に行きたいんだろ？

A New Beginning#007.src: WRAHAHHEHGHHHHOROOOARRRRR!!!!!! 'E jumps out at me... And 'e... 'e...
A New Beginning#007.dst: ウラハヘグホロオアアア！！！！！！奴が飛び出して…奴が…奴が…

A New Beginning#008.dst: 瓶には「Auburn Amaretto」というラベルが貼ってある。

A New Beginning#009.src: So, want me to take you over?

A New Beginning#010.src: What do you do for the resistance?
A New Beginning#010.dst: レジスタンスでは何を？

A New Beginning#011.src: You youngsters *hic* always poke fun... think it's make-believe... But I promises ya! 'e's real!
A New Beginning#011.dst: 若いモンは *ヒック* いつもからかう… 作り話だと思って… だが本当だ！ あいつは実在する！

A New Beginning#012.src: And I have to say: You look just like the kind of person that could take it on.
A New Beginning#012.dst: それに言わせてもらうと、あんたこそ立ち向かえそうな人だ。

A New Beginning#013.src: Owners have been listed as unloyal to the crown. Have been disposed of.
A New Beginning#013.dst: 所有者は王家への不忠者と認定。処分済み。

A New Beginning#014.src: Another region? What do you mean?
A New Beginning#014.dst: 別の地方？どういう意味？

A New Beginning#015.src: Uh... one second. Let me find them...
A New Beginning#015.dst: えっと… 待って。探すから…

A New Beginning#016.src: Understood. Now, back to- where did they go?!
A New Beginning#016.dst: 了解しました。では話を戻し― どこへ行った？！

A New Beginning#017.src: New Chapter Started: Leaves in the Wind

A New Beginning#018.src: Um. The thing at T-Torann... you w-wouldn't happen to-... n-n-nevermind. I don't need to know!
A New Beginning#018.dst: えっと。T-Torann の件… ま、まさか君が―… な、なんでもない。知らなくていい！

A New Beginning#019.src: You'll need to search quickly, in case any guards return.
A New Beginning#019.dst: 衛兵が戻ってくる前に、急いで探さないと。

A New Beginning#020.src: The door is locked from the other side.
A New Beginning#020.dst: 扉は向こう側から施錠されている。

A New Beginning#021.src: Perhaps it's accessible from another location.
A New Beginning#021.dst: 別の場所から入れるかもしれない。

A New Beginning#022.src: This must be the records room... It's locked.
A New Beginning#022.dst: ここが記録室か… 鍵がかかっている。

A New Beginning#023.src: "Only guards with appropriate clearance may access the records. If you believe a mistake has been made with your clearance level, inquire at the office."
A New Beginning#023.dst: 「記録の閲覧は相応の権限を持つ衛兵に限る。権限等級に誤りがあると思われる場合は、事務室に問い合わせること。」

A New Beginning#024.src: Wait, a suspicious person in the region- is this the cursed one?! Get them!!
A New Beginning#024.dst: 待て、この地域に不審者― 例の呪われし者か？！捕らえろ！！

A New Beginning#025.src: The Sovereign must be in the office with the key- that'd be in the other tower. You need to hurry before you're discovered.
A New Beginning#025.dst: 君主は鍵を持って事務室にいるはず― もう一つの塔だ。見つかる前に急がないと。

A New Beginning#026.src: Sovereign, sir. It seems {p} was not prepared to directly face a cursed one. Dozens of soldiers are dead.
A New Beginning#026.dst: 君主閣下。{p} は呪われし者と直接対峙する備えがなかったようです。兵士数十名が死亡。

A New Beginning#027.src: I have a dozen and a half other problems to solve that need to be pushed back- oh, would you put away the key already?
A New Beginning#027.dst: 後回しにすべき問題が十八件もあるのだ― ああ、いい加減その鍵をしまってくれないか？

A New Beginning#029.src: This must be the key that unlocks the record storage.
A New Beginning#029.dst: これが記録庫を開ける鍵に違いない。

A New Beginning#032.src: Subject brought to {p} by the Driver. (Note: Interrogate Driver for reasoning.)
A New Beginning#032.dst: 対象は Driver により {p} へ連行。(注：理由について Driver を尋問のこと)

A New Beginning#033.src: Seems to originate from Wynn Province. Matches description of one Queen's Tournament participant.
A New Beginning#033.dst: Wynn 地方の出身と見られる。女王の試練の参加者の一人と特徴が一致。

A New Beginning#034.src: Do not engage without backup or blessed equipment. Subject is dangerous, and has shown no regard for military life.
A New Beginning#034.dst: 援軍か祝福された装備なしに交戦するな。対象は危険で、兵の命を顧みない。

A New Beginning#035.src: If sighted, report to superiors immediately. Keep an eye on subject, but do not engage. Keep them in sight until-
A New Beginning#035.dst: 目撃時は直ちに上官へ報告。対象を監視せよ、ただし交戦は禁ず。視界に捉えたまま―

A New Beginning#036.src: You can't afford to be spotted. You need to take the records, and find a way out without alerting the guards.
A New Beginning#036.dst: 見つかるわけにはいかない。記録を奪い、衛兵に気づかれずに脱出する道を探さないと。

A New Beginning#038.src: ...I th-thought you were m-making things up again.
A New Beginning#038.dst: ま、また作り話をしてるのかと思ってた。

A New Beginning#039.src: Excuse you? I don't make things up! You can ask Mora, he saw it too.
A New Beginning#039.dst: はあ？作り話なんかしない！Mora に聞いてみなよ、あいつも見たんだから。

A New Beginning#040.src: If you s-say so... I just- I-I-I thought there were no p-people left out there. The c-crown keeps a whole g-garrison stationed to f-fight off... um... m-m-monsters.
A New Beginning#040.dst: そ、そう言うなら… た、ただ、ぼ、僕は外にはもう人なんていないと思ってた。お、王家は… えっと… ま、魔物を追い払うために、守備隊をまるごと置いてるし。

A New Beginning#041.src: Wh- I d-don't know! It s-s-sounded believable to me!
A New Beginning#041.dst: な― し、知らないよ！し、信じられそうに聞こえたんだ！

A New Beginning#042.src: Ugh, whatever! I don't have time for this, Zeph, I have work to do. Just... stay on your guard. I don't trust whatever's going on with this stranger.
A New Beginning#042.dst: ああ、もういい！Zeph、こんなことに付き合う暇はないの、仕事があるんだから。とにかく… 気をつけて。このよそ者の件、あたしは信用してないから。

A New Beginning#043.src: How'd you know I needed help?
A New Beginning#043.dst: 助けが要るってどうして分かった？

A New Beginning#044.src: The breeze carries the sounds of windchimes...
A New Beginning#044.dst: そよ風が風鈴の音を運んでくる…

A New Beginning#045.src: So let's get to the business at hand. I'll start with this - you're from the Wynn Province, aren't you?
A New Beginning#045.dst: では本題に入りましょう。まずはこれ― あなた、Wynn 地方から来たのでしょう？

A New Beginning#046.src: You trust me enough to tell me that?
A New Beginning#046.dst: そんなことを話すほど信用を？

A New Beginning#047.src: Even if you chose to reveal my secrets - and if anyone even believed you - you'd have no guarantee of your own safety.
A New Beginning#047.dst: たとえ私の秘密を明かしても― 信じる者がいたとしても― あなた自身の身の安全は保証されない。

A New Beginning#048.src: Something strange is happening here. I can feel it.
A New Beginning#048.dst: ここで何か奇妙なことが起きている。感じるんだ。

A New Beginning#049.src: The power you carry - the curse you bear. I have seen such things before, yet always at a distance. Never up close.
A New Beginning#049.dst: あなたの持つ力― 背負う呪い。こうしたものは前にも見たけれど、いつも遠くからだった。間近では一度も。

A New Beginning#050.src: ...I have a different perspective on this story, you might imagine. The crown has wronged me, and many others. Yet, the stories hold truths to them, to some extent.
A New Beginning#050.dst: …ご想像のとおり、私はこの物語を別の視点で見ている。王家は私を、そして多くの者を虐げてきた。それでも、物語にはある程度の真実がある。

A New Beginning#051.src: I've only ever known it as magic. Where I'm from, most people can wield it.
A New Beginning#051.dst: ずっと魔法だと思ってた。故郷では大抵の人が使えるんだ。

A New Beginning#052.src: Then that leads me to my final request. Would you join our cause, and offer your help to our resistance group? Your knowledge and strength will be greatly appreciated.
A New Beginning#052.dst: では最後のお願い。私たちの大義に加わり、このレジスタンスに力を貸してくれないかしら？あなたの知識と力は大きな助けになる。

A New Beginning#053.dst: レジスタンスに加わるよ。

A New Beginning#054.src: Um... wait, can I ask- actually... nevermind.
A New Beginning#054.dst: えっと… 待って、聞いてもいい― やっぱり… なんでもない。

A New Beginning#055.src: Well, welcome to the Leaves in the Wind! Pardon the hesitation earlier, the cursed are a... sensitive subject. If Syndra believes you to be safe, I will choose to believe her.
A New Beginning#055.dst: では、風の葉へようこそ！先ほどは躊躇してすみません、呪われし者は… 繊細な話題でしてね。Syndra があなたを安全と見るなら、私も信じましょう。

A New Beginning#056.src: It's always nice to have some fresh blood under our canopy! No matter how abnormal. We may wait for Syndra's return before getting you properly settled in.
A New Beginning#056.dst: この樹冠の下に新しい血が加わるのはいつでも嬉しいものです！どれほど異質でもね。きちんと落ち着いてもらうのは、Syndra の帰りを待ってからにしましょう。

A New Beginning#057.src: If you have any issues whatsoever, don't hesitate to inform me!
A New Beginning#057.dst: 何か問題があれば、遠慮なく私に言ってください！

A New Beginning#058.src: I am Syndra's right hand! I deal with many of the tasks involving our family here, to lighten the workload she places upon herself.
A New Beginning#058.dst: 私は Syndra の右腕です！彼女が自分に課す負担を軽くするため、ここの家族に関わる仕事の多くを引き受けています。

A New Beginning#059.src: Such tasks could include onboarding new recruits, assigning members to various missions... handling disputes- that sort of thing.
A New Beginning#059.dst: 新入りの受け入れ、各任務への人員配置… 揉め事の処理― そういったことですね。

A New Beginning#060.src: Of course, my "official" occupation by the crown's terms is that of a lumberjack. Fighting for a better future isn't exactly a well paying job, hoho!
A New Beginning#060.dst: もちろん、王家の定める「公式」な職業は木こりです。より良い未来のための戦いは、稼ぎのいい仕事とは言えませんからね、ほほ！

A New Beginning#061.src: I'm a tactician, otherwise. Not the tactician- that'd be Syndra- but... y'know.
A New Beginning#061.dst: 普段は戦術担当。「あの」戦術家じゃない― それは Syndra… 分かるでしょ。

A New Beginning#062.src: No, you didn't- ugh! It's not you personally, it's just...
A New Beginning#062.dst: 違う、あんたが― ああもう！あんた個人のせいじゃなくて、ただ…

A New Beginning#065.src: Yes... A toddler could calculate that by watching you. I'll solve that problem for you. Keep them out of trouble, and we won't have any issues- as usual.
A New Beginning#065.dst: ああ… 君を見ていれば幼児でも計算できる。その問題は私が解いてやろう。彼らが面倒を起こさなければ、何の問題もない― いつも通りだ。

A New Beginning#067.src: Simple - I don't. You don't need to worry about him. As I said, we have an agreement. He doesn't know about anything we do.
A New Beginning#067.dst: 簡単よ― 信用していない。彼のことは心配しなくていい。言ったとおり、取り決めがあるの。私たちの活動を彼は何も知らない。

A New Beginning#068.src: You shouldn't get near a running saw that big! Find a way to disable it first.
A New Beginning#068.dst: 動いている大ノコギリに近づくな！まず止める方法を探そう。

A New Beginning#070.src: Halt! I'll need to see some form of identification.
A New Beginning#070.dst: 止まれ！身分証を見せてもらおう。
A New Beginning#070.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#071.src: New policy, sorry for the inconvenience. We're heightening security around here.
A New Beginning#071.dst: 新規則でして、ご不便をおかけします。この辺りの警備を強化中なんです。
A New Beginning#071.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#072.src: It shouldn't take too much of your time, don't worry! Just show us your citizen identification papers, and we'll let you on through.
A New Beginning#072.dst: お時間はかかりませんよ、ご心配なく！市民の身分証明書を見せてもらえれば、お通しします。
A New Beginning#072.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#075.src: What's taking so long? It can't be that hard to find those. You should have them on your person at all times.
A New Beginning#075.dst: 何を手間取っている？見つけるのがそんなに難しいはずがない。常に携帯しておくべきものだぞ。
A New Beginning#075.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#076.src: It’s a very new restriction. There was some incident nearby. I’m not sure on the details, but-
A New Beginning#076.dst: ごく最近の規制なんです。近くで何か事件があったとか。詳しくは知りませんが―
A New Beginning#076.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#077.src: Enough stalling. Where are your papers?
A New Beginning#077.dst: 時間稼ぎはやめろ。書類はどこだ？
A New Beginning#077.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#078.src: If you don’t present identification, I’m going to need to take you in for questioning.
A New Beginning#078.dst: 身分証を提示しないなら、取り調べのため連行することになるぞ。
A New Beginning#078.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#079.src: O-oh, hey, th-there you are! Gosh, I was w-wondering where you'd gotten off to!
A New Beginning#079.dst: あ、ああ、そ、そこにいた！まったく、どこ行ったのかと思ったよ！

A New Beginning#080.src: Ha... d-don't tell me you forgot your papers again! I k-keep telling you to keep th-them with you...
A New Beginning#080.dst: はは… ま、また書類を忘れたなんて言わないでよ！い、いつも持ち歩けって言ってるのに…

A New Beginning#081.src: One of th-these days, you'll remember! F-for sure...
A New Beginning#081.dst: い、いつかは覚えてくれるよね！き、きっと…

A New Beginning#082.src: You d-didn’t forget our conversation too, d-did you? S-s-sorry for my friend, sir!
A New Beginning#082.dst: さ、さっきの話まで忘れてないよね？ す、すみません、うちの友人が！

A New Beginning#083.src: Ahem. I'll still need to see identification if you want to enter the city.
A New Beginning#083.dst: ゴホン。街に入りたいなら、それでも身分証は見せてもらうぞ。
A New Beginning#083.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#084.src: Oh! O-o-of course! L-let me just...

A New Beginning#085.src: ...They're a-around here s-s-somewhere, I'm s-sure... I think they m-might be
A New Beginning#085.dst: …こ、この辺にあるはず… た、たぶん―

A New Beginning#086.src: Aha! Here! Identification p-papers, just for y-you!
A New Beginning#086.dst: あった！ほら！み、身分証明書、どうぞ！

A New Beginning#087.src: ...What even is this? I can barely read the handwriting... Is that Sovereign Selium's signature? The previous sovereign?
A New Beginning#087.dst: …何だこれは？字がほとんど読めん… これは君主 Selium の署名か？先代の君主の？
A New Beginning#087.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#088.src: I've had enough of these games. The two of you are under
A New Beginning#088.dst: こんな茶番はもうたくさんだ。お前たち二人を―
A New Beginning#088.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#089.dst: そこの二人！道を空けろ！
A New Beginning#089.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#091.src: We've received more information about the incident at {p}. There's a new cursed one to look out for. Dozens of soldiers were killed in an attempt to capture them.
A New Beginning#091.dst: {p} の事件について続報が入った。警戒すべき新たな呪われし者がいる。捕縛を試みて兵士数十名が殺された。
A New Beginning#091.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#092.src: We're taking reinforcements to the fort, but I need you to remain at your posts. Keep a watchful eye on any suspicious individuals.
A New Beginning#092.dst: 砦へ増援を連れていくが、お前たちは持ち場に残れ。不審な者には目を光らせておけ。
A New Beginning#092.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#093.src: ...Th-this might be a good time to run. While they're distracted! Quick, f-follow me!
A New Beginning#093.dst: …い、今が逃げどきかも。あいつらの気がそれてるうちに！早く、つ、ついてきて！

A New Beginning#094.src: Understood. Now, back to where did they go?!
A New Beginning#094.dst: 了解しました。では話を戻し… どこへ行った？！
A New Beginning#094.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#096.src: Phew... G-glad we got out of there...
A New Beginning#096.dst: ふう… ぬ、抜け出せてよかった…

A New Beginning#097.src: A-anyway. What were you th-thinking? Trying to enter the city without p-papers...
A New Beginning#097.dst: と、ともかく。何考えてたの？しょ、書類もなしに街に入ろうなんて…

A New Beginning#098.src: You're n-new around here, right? Transferred in f-from elsewhere. Y-you're interesting, though.
A New Beginning#098.dst: こ、この辺は初めてだよね？よそから配属されてきた。で、でも、君って面白いね。

A New Beginning#099.src: Um. The thing at T-Torann... you w-wouldn't happen to... n-n-nevermind. I don't need to know!
A New Beginning#099.dst: えっと。T-Torann の件… ま、まさか君が… な、なんでもない。知らなくていい！

A New Beginning#100.src: But, if y-you're interested... The military k-keeps records of these sorts of things! Th-they want a paper trail... or s-something.
A New Beginning#100.dst: でも、き、興味があるなら… 軍はこういうことを記録してるんだ！記録を残したいとか… な、なんとか。

A New Beginning#101.src: You d-didn't hear this from me... but the l-leaves have whispered something about th-the location of a record storage. Here, hand me that b-book of yours...
A New Beginning#101.dst: ぼ、僕から聞いたとは言わないでね… でも、葉っぱたちが記録庫の場所をささやいてたんだ。ほら、その本を貸して…

A New Beginning#102.src: Well, good luck s-stranger! If anyone asks, we never m-met. But, um... y-you can call me Zeph.
A New Beginning#102.dst: じゃあ幸運を、よそ者さん！聞かれても僕らは会ってない。でも、えっと… Zeph って呼んで。
A New Beginning#102.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#103.src: Find your report in the storage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#103.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の記録庫で自分の報告書を探す。

A New Beginning#104.dst: ぼ、僕らは会ってない、いいね？
A New Beginning#104.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#105.src: HALT! Intruder! For trespassing on restricted property, you are under
A New Beginning#105.dst: 止まれ！侵入者め！立入禁止区域への不法侵入により、お前を―
A New Beginning#105.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#106.src: Wait, a suspicious person in the region is this the cursed one?! Get them!!
A New Beginning#106.dst: 待て、この地域に不審者… 例の呪われし者か？！捕らえろ！！
A New Beginning#106.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#107.dst: 奴らの狙いは… 君主 Zhiraok… や、やめ… お前…
A New Beginning#107.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#108.src: Well? You've crunched the numbers. Give me the report.
A New Beginning#108.dst: で？数字は弾いたのだろう。報告を。
A New Beginning#108.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#109.src: Sovereign, sir. It seems {p} was not directly prepared to face a cursed one. Dozens of soldiers are dead.
A New Beginning#109.dst: 君主閣下。{p} は呪われし者に正面から対処する備えがなかった模様。兵士数十名が死亡。
A New Beginning#109.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#110.src: ...of all the possibilities. How could that have factored out...? Hm. Who was the commanding officer? Their take on the problem would help fill the gaps.
A New Beginning#110.dst: …あらゆる可能性の中で。どうしてそんな解になる…？ふむ。指揮官は誰だ？その者の見解があれば欠けた項を埋められる。
A New Beginning#110.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#111.src: Well... it seems it was Commander Lilles, sir. But he was one of the casualties of the incident, and a replacement has yet to be promoted.
A New Beginning#111.dst: それが… Lilles 指揮官だったようです、閣下。しかし彼もこの事件の犠牲者の一人で、後任はまだ昇進していません。
A New Beginning#111.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#112.src: Naturally... I'll need to get hold of his family later and break the news. What else do you have on the Cursed One?
A New Beginning#112.dst: 当然か… 後で遺族に連絡して知らせねばな。呪われし者について他に何がある？
A New Beginning#112.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#113.src: I've heard reports that they're... from outside. Possibly one of the ones who were invited into our province recently, though nobody seems certain on that.
A New Beginning#113.dst: その者は… 外から来たとの報告を聞いています。最近この地方に招かれた者の一人かもしれませんが、確かなことは誰にも。
A New Beginning#113.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#114.src: We've already raised security in {p}, and we have forces moving to Torann.
A New Beginning#114.dst: {p} の警備はすでに強化し、Torann へ部隊を移動中です。
A New Beginning#114.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#115.src: One positive in a sea of negatives, I suppose. Good work. File the report in the records room, and then we'll go view the damages for ourselves.
A New Beginning#115.dst: 負の海に正が一つ、というところか。よくやった。報告書は記録室に綴じておけ。それから我々で被害を見に行く。
A New Beginning#115.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#116.src: One more thing. Since Torann is compromised, we've taken the liberty of storing the cursed one's report here, so
A New Beginning#116.dst: もう一点。Torann が陥落したため、勝手ながら呪われし者の報告書をここに保管しましたので―
A New Beginning#116.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#117.src: Do we not have a higher priority right now?!
A New Beginning#117.dst: 今はもっと優先すべきことがあるだろう？！
A New Beginning#117.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#118.src: ...N-n-no, sir. My- my apologies. I simply thought
A New Beginning#118.dst: …い、いいえ、閣下。も、申し訳ありません。ただ、私は―
A New Beginning#118.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#119.src: I have a dozen and a half other problems to solve that need to be pushed back oh, would you put away the key already?
A New Beginning#119.dst: 後回しにすべき問題が十八件もあるのだ… ああ、いい加減その鍵をしまってくれないか？
A New Beginning#119.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#120.src: We haven't got time to sit around like this when there's a tragedy of that value to look into! We need to get to {p}, yesterday!
A New Beginning#120.dst: それほどの惨事を調べねばならんのに、ここでのんびりしている暇はない！昨日のうちに {p} へ着いていたいくらいだ！
A New Beginning#120.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#121.src: Locate the key inside the eastern tower and retrieve your report.
A New Beginning#121.dst: 東の塔で鍵を見つけ、報告書を取り戻す。

A New Beginning#122.src: * Subject brought to {p} by the Driver. (Note: Interrogate Driver for reasoning.)
A New Beginning#122.dst: * 対象は Driver により {p} へ連行。(注：理由について Driver を尋問のこと)
A New Beginning#122.speaker: "Unknown Cursed One"

A New Beginning#124.src: Someone's been here... search the outpost, quickly!
A New Beginning#124.dst: 誰かがここにいた… 前哨基地を捜索しろ、急げ！

A New Beginning#125.src: Find a way out of Nexiph Outpost.
A New Beginning#125.dst: Nexiph Outpost から出る方法を探す。

A New Beginning#126.dst: し、しっかりつかまって！

A New Beginning#127.src: H-hey again, at the w-window! Tough s-situation, huh?
A New Beginning#127.dst: や、やあ、また会ったね、窓のとこで！た、大変な状況だね？
A New Beginning#127.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#128.src: I f-figured you could use a hand... Stand back a m-moment.
A New Beginning#128.dst: て、手を貸そうかと思って… ちょ、ちょっと下がってて。
A New Beginning#128.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#130.src: I-I'll be down in a bit. Just h-hold on tight to the rope, and you'll be f-fine!
A New Beginning#130.dst: ぼ、僕もすぐ降りる。ロープにしっかりつかまってれば、だ、大丈夫！
A New Beginning#130.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#131.src: Talk to Rex and Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#131.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Rex と Zeph に話しかける。

A New Beginning#132.src: Phew! W-we got you out. G-good work back there, though!
A New Beginning#132.dst: ふう！だ、脱出成功。で、でも、さっきはよくやったね！
A New Beginning#132.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#134.src: D-don't mind her, she's just like that. Rex, this is
A New Beginning#134.dst: き、気にしないで、彼女はいつもこうなんだ。Rex、こちらは―
A New Beginning#134.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#135.src: The stranger you found trying to get into {p} without identification, I know. Do you really need me here still?
A New Beginning#135.dst: 身分証もなしに {p} に入ろうとしてたよそ者でしょ、知ってる。あたし、まだここにいる必要ある？
A New Beginning#135.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#136.src: ...I-I-I'd like it if you s-stayed, yes.
A New Beginning#136.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#138.src: Um... I- I don't think I c-c-caught your name.
A New Beginning#138.dst: えっと… き、君の名前、ま、まだ聞いてなかったよね。
A New Beginning#138.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#139.src: {u}... so, wh-where are you from? Y-you must've transferred in from an-another region, right?
A New Beginning#139.dst: {u}… それで、ど、どこから来たの？べ、別の地域から配属されたんだよね？
A New Beginning#139.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#140.src: Another... um... wh-what do you-... you d-don't know?
A New Beginning#140.dst: 別の… えっと… ど、どういう― し、知らないの？
A New Beginning#140.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#141.src: Obviously they're not from here, Zeph! Remember that thing I told you about? The big spectacle event they had with people from beyond the gates?
A New Beginning#141.dst: どう見てもここの人間じゃないでしょ、Zeph！前に話したあれ、覚えてる？門の向こうから来た人たちを集めた大がかりな催し？
A New Beginning#141.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#142.src: You w-w-what?! But, there’s- th-that’s not possible...
A New Beginning#142.dst: な、な、何だって？！でも、そんな― そ、そんなのありえない…
A New Beginning#142.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#143.src: Possible or not, they’re obviously from outside the province! They’re probably involved with that big spectacle event with people from beyond the gates that I was telling you about.
A New Beginning#143.dst: ありえるかどうかじゃない、どう見ても地方の外から来たんだって！前に話した、門の向こうから人が来たあの大がかりな催しに関わってるんだよ、たぶん。
A New Beginning#143.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#144.src: …I th-thought you were m-making things up again.
A New Beginning#144.dst: ま、また作り話をしてるのかと思ってた。
A New Beginning#144.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#145.src: Excuse you? I don’t make things up! You can ask Mora, he saw it too.
A New Beginning#145.dst: はあ？作り話なんかしない！Mora に聞いてみなよ、あいつも見たんだから。
A New Beginning#145.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#146.src: If you s-say so… I just- I-I-I thought there were no p-people left out there. The c-crown keeps a whole g-garrison stationed to f-fight off… um… m-m-monsters.
A New Beginning#146.dst: そ、そう言うなら… た、ただ、ぼ、僕は外にはもう人なんていないと思ってた。お、王家は… えっと… ま、魔物を追い払うために、守備隊をまるごと置いてるし。
A New Beginning#146.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#147.dst: それを信じたの？本気で？
A New Beginning#147.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#148.src: Wh- I d-don’t know! It s-s-sounded believable to me!
A New Beginning#148.dst: な― し、知らないよ！し、信じられそうに聞こえたんだ！
A New Beginning#148.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#149.src: Ugh, whatever! I don’t have time for this. Zeph, I have work to do. Just… stay on your guard. I don’t trust whatever’s going on with this stranger.
A New Beginning#149.dst: ああ、もういい！付き合ってる暇はない。Zeph、あたしは仕事があるの。とにかく… 気をつけて。このよそ者の件、信用してないから。
A New Beginning#149.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#151.src: She's- um... she's n-not normally like this. S-sorry about that.
A New Beginning#151.dst: か、彼女… えっと… いつもはこうじゃないんだ。ご、ごめんね。
A New Beginning#151.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#152.src: O-Oh! I f-followed you, of course.
A New Beginning#152.dst: あっ！も、もちろん尾けてきた。
A New Beginning#152.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#153.src: A s-stranger comes to our region without p-papers and is supposedly a c-cursed one? I wasn't letting you go th-that easily!
A New Beginning#153.dst: しょ、書類もないよそ者がここに来て、の、呪われし者かもしれない？そう簡単に逃がすわけないよ！
A New Beginning#153.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#154.src: O-Oh! N-no problem! It was... it w-was nothing. Y-you did most of the work.
A New Beginning#154.dst: あ、ああ！べ、別にいいよ！大したことない。ほとんど君がやったんだし。
A New Beginning#154.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#155.src: N-Nixeph is... n-not an easy place to break into! I g-guess all the guards were gone.
A New Beginning#155.dst: Nixeph は… か、簡単に忍び込める場所じゃない！え、衛兵がみんな出払ってたんだろうね。
A New Beginning#155.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#156.src: But, um... y-you got what you needed, and I got what I- what I needed, s-so...
A New Beginning#156.dst: でも、えっと… 君も僕も欲しいものを、て、手に入れたし、だから…
A New Beginning#156.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#157.src: B-besides! I had s-something I needed to get from... f-from the outpost, anyway.
A New Beginning#157.dst: そ、それに！ぼ、僕も前哨基地から… と、取ってくるものがあったんだ。
A New Beginning#157.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#158.src: Um... th-there is someone you should meet. I was told to pass on a m-message...
A New Beginning#158.dst: えっと… あ、会ってほしい人がいるんだ。伝言を頼まれてて…
A New Beginning#158.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#159.src: And- and you'll be on y-your own this time. N-no help from me!
A New Beginning#159.dst: そ、それと、今回は一人で行って。ぼ、僕は手伝わないよ！
A New Beginning#159.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#160.src: The m-message is: w-westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they s-sing along.
A New Beginning#160.dst: で、伝言はこう。に、西に巨人は根を張る。風が吹けば、彼らは共に歌う。
A New Beginning#160.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#161.src: "Westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they sing along."
A New Beginning#161.dst: 「西に巨人は根を張る。風が吹けば、彼らは共に歌う。」

A New Beginning#162.src: The m-message is: w-westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they s-sing along.
A New Beginning#162.dst: で、伝言はこう。に、西に巨人は根を張る。風が吹けば、彼らは共に歌う。
A New Beginning#162.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#163.src: Talk to the woman in the cave.
A New Beginning#163.dst: 洞窟の中の女性と話す。

A New Beginning#164.src: Well, well. If it isn't a fresh breeze dancing in the leaves...
A New Beginning#164.dst: あら、あら。葉の間を舞う新しいそよ風じゃないの…

A New Beginning#165.src: You must be the Cursed One who caused such a stir at Torann, yes? News has spread quickly of your actions.
A New Beginning#165.dst: Torann であれほどの騒ぎを起こした呪われし者ね？あなたの行いはすぐに広まった。

A New Beginning#166.src: I'm impressed you found your way to me.
A New Beginning#166.dst: よくここを見つけたわね。感心した。

A New Beginning#167.src: So let's get to the business at hand. I'll start with this you're from the Wynn Province, aren't you?
A New Beginning#167.dst: では本題に入りましょう。まずはこれ… あなた、Wynn 地方から来たのでしょう？

A New Beginning#168.src: I thought so... You're certainly not from around here. Though, I would recommend you keep that information close to your chest.
A New Beginning#168.dst: やっぱり… 明らかにこの辺りの人じゃない。でも、そのことは胸にしまっておくことを勧めるわ。

A New Beginning#169.src: Very few people have knowledge of the outside world, and those that do... they're the ones who will be looking for you. Best to avoid drawing their attention.
A New Beginning#169.dst: 外の世界を知る者はごく僅か。そして知っている者たちこそ… あなたを探しに来る。目をつけられないほうがいい。

A New Beginning#170.src: But I should introduce myself. My name is Syndra, leader of the Leaves in the Wind resistance group.
A New Beginning#170.dst: でも自己紹介をしないとね。私は Syndra、レジスタンス組織「風の葉」の指導者よ。
A New Beginning#170.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#171.src: Call it something of a gamble. Given your... shall we say, explosive entrance into the province, I find it unlikely you're with the crown.
A New Beginning#171.dst: 一種の賭けね。あなたの… そう、派手な入国の仕方を見れば、王家の側の人間とは思えない。
A New Beginning#171.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#172.src: Even if you chose to reveal my secrets and if anyone even believed you you'd have no guarantee of your own safety.
A New Beginning#172.dst: たとえ私の秘密を明かしても、信じる者がいたとしても、あなた自身の身の安全は保証されない。
A New Beginning#172.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#173.src: Yes. You haven’t been here long, but you’ve felt it, haven’t you? The crown has its roots buried deep in this province, and it certainly isn’t kind to all.
A New Beginning#173.dst: ええ。来て間もないけれど、感じたでしょう？王家はこの地方に深く根を張っていて、誰にでも優しいわけではない。
A New Beginning#173.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#174.src: Those it sees as disposable… they don’t often make it far. That is why I have taken my role. I’d like to see a day where none are left behind.
A New Beginning#174.dst: 使い捨てと見なされた者は… 長くはもたない。だから私はこの役目を担った。誰も取り残されない日を見たいの。
A New Beginning#174.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#175.src: But that's enough about me. On to you. Why are you here, cursed one? For what purpose have you come to Fruma?
A New Beginning#175.dst: 私の話はここまで。次はあなた。なぜここに、呪われし者？何の目的で Fruma へ？
A New Beginning#175.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#176.src: Interesting. A sense that something isn't right...
A New Beginning#176.dst: 興味深いわね。何かがおかしいという感覚…
A New Beginning#176.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#177.src: To tell you the truth, it's one I've had myself for quite some time. Though, likely for a different reason to you.
A New Beginning#177.dst: 実を言うと、私自身もずっと抱いてきた感覚よ。理由はあなたとは違うでしょうけど。
A New Beginning#177.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#178.src: A noble cause… It is one I can wholeheartedly support.
A New Beginning#178.dst: 気高い理由ね… 心から支持できるわ。
A New Beginning#178.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#179.src: In a world like this, the most we can do sometimes is hold on to those we care for. Take care not to lose that drive.
A New Beginning#179.dst: こんな世界では、大切な人を離さずにいるのが精一杯なこともある。その想いを失わないで。
A New Beginning#179.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#180.src: Then, I would ask of you one more thing. A test, in a way...
A New Beginning#180.dst: では、もう一つお願いがあるの。ある意味、試験ね…
A New Beginning#180.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#181.src: The power you carry the curse you bear. I have seen such things before, yet always at a distance. Never up close.
A New Beginning#181.dst: あなたの持つ力、背負う呪い。こうしたものは前にも見たけれど、いつも遠くからだった。間近では一度も。
A New Beginning#181.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#182.src: I would ask for a duel. Nothing dangerous, or lethal... I have safeguards in place for myself, so do not test my limits. When I call it, we stop.
A New Beginning#182.dst: 決闘を申し込みたいの。危険なものでも命がけでもない… 私には備えがあるから、限界を試さないで。私が止めたら終わりよ。
A New Beginning#182.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#183.src: I would simply like to see the strength of a cursed one in battle firsthand. So, then. Let us begin!
A New Beginning#183.dst: 呪われし者の戦う力をこの目で見たいだけ。では、始めましょう！
A New Beginning#183.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#184.dst: Syndra の試練を達成する。

A New Beginning#185.dst: そこまで！こっちへ来て。
A New Beginning#185.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#186.src: Impressive. Very impressive. I have never seen a cursed one with such control and technique...
A New Beginning#186.dst: 見事。実に見事ね。これほどの制御と技を持つ呪われし者は見たことがない…
A New Beginning#186.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#187.src: If I did not know better, I would believe you to have been blessed by the crown itself.
A New Beginning#187.dst: 事情を知らなければ、王家そのものから祝福を受けたと思うところよ。
A New Beginning#187.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#188.src: Your power, your spells. The ability to bend the world to your whim, to wield the elements for your own gain.
A New Beginning#188.dst: あなたの力、あなたの呪文。世界を思うままに曲げ、元素を己のために操る能力。
A New Beginning#188.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#189.src: Eons ago, so the stories say, the world was pure and balanced. Our people lived with the land, content with what we had.
A New Beginning#189.dst: 伝承によれば、太古の世界は清らかで均衡が保たれていた。民は大地と共に生き、足るを知っていた。
A New Beginning#189.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#190.src: And yet, an evil force lurked within us, a malice which despised our peace and happiness. One day, it burst forth, granting unimaginable power to those it deemed worthy...
A New Beginning#190.dst: けれど、私たちの内には邪悪な力が潜んでいた。平和と幸福を憎む悪意が。ある日それは噴き出し、ふさわしいと見なした者に計り知れない力を与えた…
A New Beginning#190.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#191.src: Its power could not be controlled. Those cursed by its touch went on to tear apart the land, destroying cities and towns... fear overtook the land, none were safe.
A New Beginning#191.dst: その力は制御できなかった。触れて呪われた者たちは大地を引き裂き、都市や町を滅ぼした… 恐怖が大地を覆い、安全な者はいなかった。
A New Beginning#191.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#192.src: Until she arrived, a force of good to counter the evil. She granted her own blessings to the people of Fruma, power which could be controlled and wielded to banish the cursed.
A New Beginning#192.dst: そこへ彼女が現れた。悪に抗う善の力として。彼女は Fruma の民に自らの祝福を授けた。制御でき、呪われし者を退けるために振るえる力を。
A New Beginning#192.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#193.src: She saved our province, and became our immortal Queen. Always looking out for the people, always alert for the presence of evil... for it could not be killed, only staved off.
A New Beginning#193.dst: 彼女はこの地方を救い、不死の女王となった。常に民を見守り、常に悪の気配に目を光らせて… それは殺せず、遠ざけることしかできないから。
A New Beginning#193.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#194.src: The cursed ones never left. They only grew smarter, more capable of hiding from the crown's watchful eye.
A New Beginning#194.dst: 呪われし者は消えなかった。ただ賢くなり、王家の監視の目から隠れるのが巧みになっただけ。
A New Beginning#194.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#195.src: And so, it tells the people, always be aware. Always be looking for the cursed ones. It is only a matter of time before they hurt you.
A New Beginning#195.dst: だから王家は民に告げる。常に警戒せよ。常に呪われし者を探せ。彼らがお前を傷つけるのは時間の問題だ、と。
A New Beginning#195.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#196.src: ...I have a different perspective on this story, you might imagine. The crown has wronged me, and many others. Yet, the stories hold truths to them, to an extent.
A New Beginning#196.dst: …ご想像のとおり、私はこの物語を別の視点で見ている。王家は私を、そして多くの者を虐げてきた。それでも、物語にはある程度の真実がある。
A New Beginning#196.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#197.src: That is why your control over your power has interested me. It bears more traits of the crown's blessings than of the evil's curses, and yet...
A New Beginning#197.dst: だからこそ、あなたの力の制御に興味を引かれたの。邪悪の呪いより王家の祝福の特徴を多く備えている。なのに…
A New Beginning#197.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#198.src: Magic... yes, that term has been used in higher studies at the University.
A New Beginning#198.dst: 魔法… ええ、その言葉は大学の高等研究で使われているわ。
A New Beginning#198.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#199.src: But a land filled with cursed ones... and it isn't destroyed? I suppose I have had no reason to believe the crown's reports about it, but...
A New Beginning#199.dst: でも、呪われし者で満ちた土地が… 滅びていない？王家の報告を信じる理由は元々なかったけれど…
A New Beginning#199.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#200.src: I need time to process this information. But I would like to discuss it with you further, at a later date, if you would be willing.
A New Beginning#200.dst: この情報を整理する時間が要るわ。でもよければ、後日あなたともっと話し合いたいの。
A New Beginning#200.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#201.src: Then that leads me to my final request. Would you join our cause, and offer your help to our resistance group? Your knowledge and strength would be greatly appreciated.
A New Beginning#201.dst: では最後のお願い。私たちの大義に加わり、このレジスタンスに力を貸してくれないかしら？あなたの知識と力は大きな助けになる。
A New Beginning#201.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#202.src: Thank you. I will take you to meet with the others, then. Our home is directly to the south-west, it should be hard to miss. I'll meet you there.
A New Beginning#202.dst: ありがとう。では他の皆に会わせるわ。私たちの家はここから真南西、見落とすことはないはず。そこで会いましょう。
A New Beginning#202.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#203.src: Follow Syndra to the resistance base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#203.dst: Syndra について [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のレジスタンス拠点へ行く。

A New Beginning#204.src: There you are, {u}. I see you found your way here alright.
A New Beginning#204.dst: 来たわね、{u}。無事にたどり着けたみたい。
A New Beginning#204.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#205.src: If you're going to be joining us, I should introduce you to the others.
A New Beginning#205.dst: 私たちに加わるなら、皆に紹介しないとね。
A New Beginning#205.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#206.src: Ahem... Children, come on out! We have a new member I'd like you to meet.
A New Beginning#206.dst: コホン… みんな、出てきて！新しい仲間を紹介したいの。
A New Beginning#206.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#207.src: We m-meet again! I knew you'd be a g-good fit!
A New Beginning#207.dst: ま、また会ったね！き、君なら合うと思ってたよ！
A New Beginning#207.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#208.src: Yeah, Zeph, we know. You've been saying so for hours...
A New Beginning#208.dst: はいはい、Zeph、知ってる。何時間も言い続けてるじゃん…
A New Beginning#208.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#209.src: Ah, lighten up Rex. Welcome to the Leaves, friend! No matter your origin, if Syndra believes you to be trustworthy, it must be so.
A New Beginning#209.dst: まあまあ、そう硬くならずに Rex。風の葉へようこそ、友よ！出自はどうあれ、Syndra が信頼に足ると言うなら、そうなのでしょう。
A New Beginning#209.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#210.src: On that subject, {u} here is from outside of our province. They'll be joining our resistance against the crown...
A New Beginning#210.dst: そのことだけど、この {u} は私たちの地方の外から来たの。王家に対抗するレジスタンスに加わってくれる…
A New Beginning#210.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#211.src: ...and, hopefully, they'll be able to help me resolve some theories I have on the nature of curses and blessings.
A New Beginning#211.dst: …そして、呪いと祝福の本質について私が立てた仮説を確かめる手助けも、してくれるといいのだけど。
A New Beginning#211.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#213.src: Yes. But they're no threat to us. We share the same enemies. And, having that power on our side could make a huge difference for our efforts.
A New Beginning#213.dst: ええ。でも私たちの脅威ではない。敵は同じよ。それに、あの力が味方にいれば、私たちの活動は大きく変わる。
A New Beginning#213.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#214.src: Hm... are you certain, miss? I do trust your judgment, but perhaps it would be best to err on the side of caution when dealing with the cursed.
A New Beginning#214.dst: ふむ… 本当によろしいので、お嬢さん？ご判断は信じますが、呪われし者が相手なら慎重を期すのが賢明かと。
A New Beginning#214.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#215.src: The curse is the least of our problems! Are we really blindly trusting someone who says they're from Wynn? People don't just... just... come back from there!
A New Beginning#215.dst: 呪いなんて問題のうちに入らない！Wynn から来たって言う奴を本気で盲目的に信じるの？あそこから… ただ… 帰ってくる人なんていない！
A New Beginning#215.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#216.src: That's enough, Rex. I understand your misgivings, but I have reasons for my trust. I would ask you to have faith in me.
A New Beginning#216.dst: そこまでよ、Rex。不安は分かるけど、信頼するには理由がある。私を信じてほしい。
A New Beginning#216.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#218.src: Now. I still need to acquire the proper papers for {u} to be able to access {p}. In the meantime, why don't you all get to know each other properly?
A New Beginning#218.dst: さて。{u} が {p} に入るための正式な書類をまだ手に入れないと。その間、みんなでお互いをちゃんと知っておいたら？
A New Beginning#218.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#220.src: Introduce yourself to the Resistance Members are .
A New Beginning#220.dst: にいるレジスタンスのメンバーに自己紹介する。

A New Beginning#221.src: ...What do you want? Do you need something?
A New Beginning#221.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#222.src: I... shoot things? With my bow?
A New Beginning#222.dst: あたしは… 撃つ？弓で？
A New Beginning#222.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#223.src: I'm a tactician, otherwise. Not the tactician that'd be Syndra but... y'know.
A New Beginning#223.dst: 普段は戦術担当。「あの」戦術家じゃない、それは Syndra… 分かるでしょ。
A New Beginning#223.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#224.src: ...You don't know. Because look, it doesn't matter what I do! Not to you, at least.
A New Beginning#224.dst: …分からないでしょ。だって、あたしが何してようと関係ない！少なくともあんたにはね。
A New Beginning#224.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#225.src: What, are you looking for gossip?
A New Beginning#225.dst: 何、噂話でも探ってんの？
A New Beginning#225.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#226.src: Well, you're not going to get any out of me.
A New Beginning#226.dst: 言っとくけど、あたしからは何も聞き出せないから。
A New Beginning#226.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#227.src: No, you didn't ugh! It's not you personally, it's just...
A New Beginning#227.dst: 違う、あんたが… ああもう！あんた個人のせいじゃなくて、ただ…
A New Beginning#227.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#228.dst: なんでもない。どうでもいい。
A New Beginning#228.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#229.src: You're cursed, and you say you're from Wynn. Both of those are problems.
A New Beginning#229.dst: あんたは呪われてて、Wynn から来たって言う。どっちも問題だよ。
A New Beginning#229.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#230.src: I don't know what Syndra sees in you... but whatever it is, it'd better make up for both of those things.
A New Beginning#230.dst: Syndra があんたの何を見込んだのか知らないけど… 何にせよ、その二つを帳消しにするくらいじゃないとね。
A New Beginning#230.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#232.src: Well, welcome to the Leaves in the Wind! Pardon on the hesitation earlier, the cursed are a… sensitive subject. If Syndra believes you to be safe, I will choose to believe her.
A New Beginning#232.dst: では、風の葉へようこそ！先ほどは躊躇してすみません、呪われし者は… 繊細な話題でしてね。Syndra があなたを安全と見るなら、私も信じましょう。
A New Beginning#232.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#233.src: It’s always nice to have some fresh blood under our canopy! No matter how abnormal. We may wait for Syndra’s return before getting you properly settled in.
A New Beginning#233.dst: この樹冠の下に新しい血が加わるのはいつでも嬉しいものです！どれほど異質でもね。きちんと落ち着いてもらうのは、Syndra の帰りを待ってからにしましょう。
A New Beginning#233.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#234.src: If you have any issues whatsoever, don’t hesitate to inform me!
A New Beginning#234.dst: 何か問題があれば、遠慮なく私に言ってください！
A New Beginning#234.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#235.src: Now, what could I do for you?
A New Beginning#235.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#236.src: I am Syndra’s right hand! I deal with many of the tasks involving our family here, to lighten the workload she places upon herself.
A New Beginning#236.dst: 私は Syndra の右腕です！彼女が自分に課す負担を軽くするため、ここの家族に関わる仕事の多くを引き受けています。
A New Beginning#236.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#237.src: Such tasks could include onboarding new recruits, assigning members to various missions… handling disputes- that sort of thing.
A New Beginning#237.dst: 新入りの受け入れ、各任務への人員配置… 揉め事の処理― そういったことですね。
A New Beginning#237.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#238.src: Of course, my “official” occupation by the crown’s terms is that of a lumberjack. Fighting for a better future isn’t exactly a well paying job, hoho!
A New Beginning#238.dst: もちろん、王家の定める「公式」な職業は木こりです。より良い未来のための戦いは、稼ぎのいい仕事とは言えませんからね、ほほ！
A New Beginning#238.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#239.src: Ah! Yes, well, these are not our full numbers. The others live elsewhere, either in town or in various villages. They stop by every so often, so perhaps you’ll have the chance to meet them later!
A New Beginning#239.dst: ああ！ええ、ここにいるのが全員ではありません。他の者は町や各地の村など、別の場所に住んでいます。時々立ち寄るので、いずれ会う機会もあるでしょう！
A New Beginning#239.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#240.src: We all are the ones who live here full-time. Nowhere else in particular we can go, if you catch my meaning.
A New Beginning#240.dst: ここに常に住んでいるのは私たちです。他に行く当てもないもので、お分かりいただけるなら。
A New Beginning#240.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#241.src: If you’re from beyond our province’s walls, I expect we’ll be wanting to set you up with a room of your own sometime… but we can discuss that later.
A New Beginning#241.dst: あなたが地方の壁の外から来たのなら、いずれ自分の部屋を用意することになるでしょう… ですが、その話はまた後で。
A New Beginning#241.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#242.src: Indeed. I hope we can do some good work together, young leaf!
A New Beginning#242.dst: まさに。共に良い仕事ができるといいですね、若葉くん！
A New Beginning#242.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#243.src: Um... nice to meet you, I guess?
A New Beginning#243.dst: えっと… よろしく、かな？
A New Beginning#243.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#244.src: Oh... I take care of the injured. I also cook... sometimes.
A New Beginning#244.dst: あ… 私はけが人の手当てをしてるの。料理も… たまに。
A New Beginning#244.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#245.src: I'm not really much of a fighter... not much of, um, anything, really.
A New Beginning#245.dst: 戦うのは得意じゃなくて… えっと、何も得意じゃない、かな。
A New Beginning#245.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#246.src: I'm mostly just here because of Mora... he's, um, my brother.
A New Beginning#246.dst: ここにいるのは、ほとんど Mora のおかげで… 彼、えっと、兄なの。
A New Beginning#246.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#248.src: Um... wait, can I ask actually... nevermind.
A New Beginning#248.dst: えっと… 待って、聞いてもいい… やっぱり… なんでもない。
A New Beginning#248.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#249.src: I'm g-glad you were able to c-convince Syndra to let you j-join! It'll be n-nice having someone new a-around.
A New Beginning#249.dst: し、Syndra を説得して加われて、よ、よかったね！新しい人がいるのは、い、いいもんだよ。
A New Beginning#249.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#251.src: I... d-don't know, actually. It looks like she's h-heading towards the F-Frog Tavern... but why...?
A New Beginning#251.dst: ぼ、僕も… 実は分からない。カ、カエル亭に向かってるみたいだけど… なんで…？
A New Beginning#251.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#252.src: Hey... {u}. How'd you l-like to have your first of-official resistance mission with me?
A New Beginning#252.dst: ねえ… {u}。ぼ、僕と一緒に初めてのせ、正式なレジスタンス任務をやってみない？
A New Beginning#252.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#253.src: I-I want to f-follow her and see what she g-gets up to at a r-random bar, of all places...
A New Beginning#253.dst: か、彼女を尾けて、よりにもよって、ふ、普通の酒場で何をするのか見たいんだ…
A New Beginning#253.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#254.src: You know, I-I-I've always suspected that the t-tavern isn't what it a-appears to be!
A New Beginning#254.dst: あのね、ぼ、僕はずっと、あの酒場は見かけどおりじゃないって、う、疑ってたんだ！
A New Beginning#254.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#255.dst: …み、みんなには被害妄想だって。
A New Beginning#255.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#256.dst: う、うん！そ、その意気だよ！
A New Beginning#256.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#257.src: Wh- I- n-no! I j-just want to m-m-make sure she's okay. Th-that's all.
A New Beginning#257.dst: な― ぼ― ち、違う！か、彼女が無事か確かめたいだけ。そ、それだけ。
A New Beginning#257.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#258.src: Let's m-meet up at the tavern. It's j-just to the north of here.
A New Beginning#258.dst: さ、酒場で落ち合おう。こ、ここのすぐ北だよ。
A New Beginning#258.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#259.src: I m-mainly gather intel for the resistance! Th-that usually involves needing to st-stay hidden.
A New Beginning#259.dst: ぼ、僕は主にレジスタンスの情報集めをしてる！だ、だいたいは隠れてなきゃいけないんだ。
A New Beginning#259.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#260.src: I've picked up a t-t-trick or two over the y-years.
A New Beginning#260.dst: 何年もかけて、い、いくつかコツを覚えたんだ。
A New Beginning#260.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#261.src: S-sometimes I sell stuff I f-find in the forest in town! B-but that's not really f-for the resistance. That's for m-me.
A New Beginning#261.dst: と、ときどき森で拾ったものを町で売ってる！で、でもそれはレジスタンスのためじゃない。ぼ、僕のため。
A New Beginning#261.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#262.src: Huh? Oh, r-right! I was l-looking for guard rotations, for th-the upcoming festival.
A New Beginning#262.dst: え？あ、そ、そうだ！今度の祭りに向けて、え、衛兵の交代表を探してたんだ。
A New Beginning#262.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#263.src: S-security is usually pretty high, so... it's g-good to know where and when is s-s-safe.
A New Beginning#263.dst: け、警備はふだん厳しいから… いつどこがあ、安全か知っとくと役に立つんだ。
A New Beginning#263.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#264.src: I-I've been wondering the s-same thing...
A New Beginning#264.dst: ぼ、僕も同じことを考えてた…
A New Beginning#264.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#265.src: She usually isn't l-like this! I wonder if s-something's wrong...
A New Beginning#265.dst: か、彼女、ふだんはこんなじゃないのに！な、何かあったのかな…
A New Beginning#265.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#266.src: ...I can t-talk to her about it later.
A New Beginning#266.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#267.dst: き、君がいてくれてよかった！
A New Beginning#267.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#268.src: Meet up with Zeph outside the Frog Tavern at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#268.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のカエル亭の外で Zeph と落ち合う。

A New Beginning#269.src: W-wait. We can't j-just go through the f-front, she'll s-see us.
A New Beginning#269.dst: ま、待って。正面からは入れない、か、彼女に見られる。
A New Beginning#269.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#271.src: You'll get s-spotted! Let's get in from above i-instead.
A New Beginning#271.dst: み、見つかっちゃう！う、上から入ろう。
A New Beginning#271.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#272.src: Sneak into the Frog Tavern at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#273.src: R-right behind you. D-don't get spotted!
A New Beginning#273.dst: う、後ろにいるよ。見つからないで！
A New Beginning#273.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#274.src: Th-there she is! I w-wonder what she's
A New Beginning#274.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#277.src: You interrupt my sequence like this and won't even say my name? Come on, now.
A New Beginning#277.dst: 私の数列をこうして遮っておいて、名前も呼ばないのか？おいおい。
A New Beginning#277.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#278.src: Bartender, my usual mix. I need a boost.
A New Beginning#278.dst: マスター、いつものを。景気づけだ。
A New Beginning#278.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#279.dst: ずいぶん… 疲れているようね。
A New Beginning#279.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#280.src: Oh, thank you for noticing! It's because of the stress. Look, I know you're aware of the attack on Torann by now. You've always kept up with the details.
A New Beginning#280.dst: おお、気づいてくれてありがとう！ストレスのせいだ。なあ、Torann の襲撃はもう知っているだろう。君はいつも細部まで把握しているからな。
A New Beginning#280.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#281.src: But how about we accelerate this. You know how little time I have and you didn't bring me here just for drinks.
A New Beginning#281.dst: だが、話を加速させよう。私に時間がないのは知っているし、酒のためだけに呼んだわけでもあるまい。
A New Beginning#281.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#282.src: Skipping the small talk, I see. Are my intentions really that transparent?
A New Beginning#282.dst: 世間話は飛ばすのね。私の意図、そんなに見え透いてる？
A New Beginning#282.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#283.src: Predictable, more like, after all this time. You've always got an angle you're working towards when you call me here.
A New Beginning#283.dst: 予測可能、と言うべきだな。これだけ長い付き合いだ。君が私を呼ぶときは、いつも狙う角度がある。
A New Beginning#283.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#284.src: Maybe I just like the ambience.
A New Beginning#284.dst: ここの雰囲気が好きなだけかも。
A New Beginning#284.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#285.src: ...I need another passport. Same as the rest.
A New Beginning#285.dst: …パスポートがもう一つ要るの。他のと同じものを。
A New Beginning#285.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#286.src: Naturally. You and your trend for collecting strays... Really you should just start a family by this point.
A New Beginning#286.dst: 当然だな。君の迷い子を拾う癖ときたら… いい加減、家庭でも持ったらどうだ。
A New Beginning#286.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#287.src: You of all people should know that I can't just stand by and leave them to fend for themselves.
A New Beginning#287.dst: あなたなら分かるはずよ。私が彼らを見捨てて傍観なんてできないって。
A New Beginning#287.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#288.src: Yes... A toddler could calculate that by watching you. I'll solve that problem for you. Keep them out of trouble, and we won't have any issues as usual.
A New Beginning#288.dst: ああ… 君を見ていれば幼児でも計算できる。その問題は私が解いてやろう。彼らが面倒を起こさなければ、何の問題もない… いつも通りだ。
A New Beginning#288.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#289.src: Of course. As I always do.
A New Beginning#289.dst: もちろん。いつもどおりにね。
A New Beginning#289.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#290.src: Ha! "Always." If I were a gambling man I'd never bet on your odds.
A New Beginning#290.dst: はっ！「いつも」か。私が賭博師なら、君の勝率には絶対に賭けないね。
A New Beginning#290.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#291.src: I need to get moving. There's always something that needs me to crunch the numbers... and today's events have only added to the pile.
A New Beginning#291.dst: そろそろ行かねば。数字を弾かねばならん案件は常にある… 今日の出来事で山がさらに増えた。
A New Beginning#291.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#292.src: I certainly wouldn't want to delay you, Sovereign. I hope you manage to sort out all these problems.
A New Beginning#292.dst: 引き留めるつもりはないわ、君主。問題がすべて片付くといいわね。
A New Beginning#292.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#293.src: Oh, we will. It's only a matter of time. Take care, Syndra. Keep it constant.
A New Beginning#293.dst: ああ、片付くさ。時間の問題だ。元気でな、Syndra。常に一定であれ。
A New Beginning#293.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#295.src: Sigh. You may as well come down now. Zeph, {u}.
A New Beginning#295.dst: はあ。もう降りてきていいわよ。Zeph、{u}。
A New Beginning#295.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#296.dst: く、くそ… み、見つかった。
A New Beginning#296.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#297.src: That was... risky. You're lucky he didn't look up.
A New Beginning#297.dst: 今のは… 危なかった。彼が見上げなかったのは運がよかったわね。
A New Beginning#297.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#298.src: S-sure, but- b-but what were you d-doing meeting up w-with him?!
A New Beginning#298.dst: そ、そうだけど― な、なんで彼と会ってたの？！
A New Beginning#298.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#299.src: Its... complicated we have something of an agreement. What matters is that everything is taken care of. Since you're here, {u}, take this. Your passport.
A New Beginning#299.dst: 複雑なのよ… 取り決めのようなものがあるの。大事なのは、全部片付いたということ。ちょうどいい、{u}、これを。あなたのパスポートよ。
A New Beginning#299.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#300.src: It's... complicated - we have something of an agreement. What matters is that everything is taken care of. Since you're here, {u}, take this. Your passport.
A New Beginning#300.dst: それは…複雑なの- ちょっとした取り決めがあってね。大事なのは全部片付いたってこと。ここにいるなら {u}、これを。あなたのパスポートよ。
A New Beginning#300.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#301.src: He's... h-he's with the c-crown, though. H-how can you t-trust him?
A New Beginning#301.dst: で、でも彼は… お、王家側の人だよ。ど、どうして信用できるの？
A New Beginning#301.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#302.src: Simple I don't. You don't need to worry about him. As I said, we have an agreement. He doesn't know about anything we do.
A New Beginning#302.dst: 簡単よ、信用していない。彼のことは心配しなくていい。言ったとおり、取り決めがあるの。私たちの活動を彼は何も知らない。
A New Beginning#302.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#303.src: I had hoped to keep this a secret for a reason... but what's done is done. Just... don't do anything rash, would you?
A New Beginning#303.dst: 理由があって秘密にしておきたかったのだけど… 済んだことは仕方ない。ただ… 早まった真似はしないでね？
A New Beginning#303.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#304.src: {u}, your passport will let you enter the city. I'd suggest you take some time to visit and look around, to familiarize yourself with the place.
A New Beginning#304.dst: {u}、そのパスポートで街に入れるわ。少し時間をとって見て回り、街に慣れておくといい。
A New Beginning#304.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#305.src: And when you have time... I'd like to follow up on our discussion we had earlier. I think it's time we start taking steps forward.
A New Beginning#305.dst: それから時間ができたら… 前にした話の続きをしたいの。そろそろ前に進む時だと思う。
A New Beginning#305.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#306.src: I'll be returning to our home. Zeph, you can come with me if you'd like.
A New Beginning#306.dst: 私は家に戻るわ。Zeph、よければ一緒に来る？
A New Beginning#306.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#307.dst: そ、そうだね… じゃ、またね、{u}。
A New Beginning#307.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#309.src: Ugh. What do you want? I'm clearly busy.
A New Beginning#309.dst: はあ。何の用？見ての通り忙しいんだけど。
A New Beginning#309.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#311.src: No, just... leave me alone, okay? I don't want to talk to you.
A New Beginning#311.dst: いや、ただ… ほっといてくれる？あんたと話したくない。
A New Beginning#311.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#314.src: Ah! You ca-caught- caught me off guard. How's your time in Auburn bee-been?
A New Beginning#314.dst: わっ！び、びっく― びっくりした。Auburn での暮らしは、ど、どう？
A New Beginning#314.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#315.src: Yup! I've s-s-stayed here the longest so I've ma-managed to gather quite the assortment of useful stuff. Rex w-w-would call it junk but...
A New Beginning#315.dst: うん！ぼ、僕がここに一番長くいるから、や、役立つものをけっこう集めたんだ。Rex は、が、がらくたって言うけど…
A New Beginning#315.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#316.src: An old friend a-actually helped me make this training dum-dummy.
A New Beginning#316.dst: こ、この訓練用のか、かかしは、昔の友達が作るのを手伝ってくれたんだ。
A New Beginning#316.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#317.src: Gotta stay on t-top of my training! Especially with you here.
A New Beginning#317.dst: く、訓練は怠れない！特に君が来たからにはね。
A New Beginning#317.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#318.src: Besides, I wa-wa-want I want to be able to help when it matters.
A New Beginning#318.dst: そ、それに、ぼ、僕は― 大事なときに助けになりたいんだ。
A New Beginning#318.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#319.src: We should t-train together some day.
A New Beginning#319.dst: い、いつか一緒に訓練しよう。
A New Beginning#319.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#321.src: Did you... need help with anything?
A New Beginning#321.dst: 何か… 手伝ってほしいことある？
A New Beginning#321.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#322.src: Mhm! Me, Zeph, Rex, and Mora all, um, have rooms here. Oh, and Syndra, too. And Kaio lives nearby too...
A New Beginning#322.dst: うん！私と Zeph、Rex、Mora は、えっと、ここに部屋があるの。あ、Syndra も。Kaio も近くに住んでて…
A New Beginning#322.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#323.src: I've... been meaning to decorate some more. You know... make it more, um, homely.
A New Beginning#323.dst: もっと飾りつけしようと… 思ってて。ほら… もっと、えっと、家らしく。
A New Beginning#323.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#324.src: ...but life's been getting in the way, I suppose.
A New Beginning#324.dst: …でも、いろいろあって手が回らなくて。
A New Beginning#324.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#325.src: Um! I d-don't, ha, judge me for this, but... I'm, um, writing in my diary.
A New Beginning#325.dst: えっと！わ、私、は、笑わないでね… えっと、日記を書いてるの。
A New Beginning#325.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#326.src: ...a-and before you ask! No!! You're, um, not allowed to read it.
A New Beginning#326.dst: …そ、それと聞かれる前に！だめ！！えっと、読んじゃだめだから。
A New Beginning#326.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#327.src: ...thank you. I'll, um, see you later.
A New Beginning#327.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#328.src: Hmm... Delivering mail from river settlement to {p}... Kaio... Check... Hmmm.
A New Beginning#328.dst: ふむ… 川沿いの集落から {p} への郵便配達… Kaio… 済… ふむ。
A New Beginning#328.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#329.src: Ah! {u}, do you require my assistance?
A New Beginning#329.dst: おや！{u}、何かお手伝いしましょうか？
A New Beginning#329.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#330.src: Ah... You overheard me talking to myself, then. Hoh!
A New Beginning#330.dst: ああ… 独り言を聞かれてしまいましたか。ほほ！
A New Beginning#330.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#331.src: I am just writing and filing some reports I had forgotten about. We are trying to keep better track of our activities throughout the forest, you see.
A New Beginning#331.dst: 忘れていた報告書を書いて綴じているだけです。森での私たちの活動を、もっときちんと記録しようとしていましてね。
A New Beginning#331.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#332.dst: むう… で、呪われとるのか？
A New Beginning#332.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#333.src: Hm... I guess not, thinking on it now. A few years ago, had you asked, I'd've probably said yes. But I don't got the strength in me for it anymore.
A New Beginning#333.dst: ふむ… 今考えると、せんだろうな。数年前に聞かれてたら、たぶんすると言っとった。だがもう、わしにはそんな力は残っとらん。
A New Beginning#333.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#334.src: It's good your arrival has given Syndra and the younguns some hope, for once. We've been a bit, eh... lacking in it lately.
A New Beginning#334.dst: お前さんが来て、Syndra と若いのが珍しく希望を持てたのはいいことだ。ここんとこ、ちいと… 足りとらんかったからな。
A New Beginning#334.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#335.src: I've got no such delusions, unfortunately. I reckon this path only ends in tragedy. But it's not my place to say so, so I don't.
A New Beginning#335.dst: 残念ながら、わしはそんな夢は見とらん。この道は悲劇で終わるだけだと思う。だが言う立場じゃないから、言わん。
A New Beginning#335.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#336.src: Would be good to be proven wrong... but I don't think I will be. I've seen this sorta thing before.
A New Beginning#336.dst: 間違っとったと証明されたらいいんだが… そうはならんだろう。こういうのは前にも見た。
A New Beginning#336.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#337.src: ...what? I got nothin' else to say.
A New Beginning#337.dst: …何だ？もう話すことはないぞ。
A New Beginning#337.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#338.src: Interesting that you're drawn to that grave in particular. S'our latest loss, that'n there.
A New Beginning#338.dst: よりによってその墓に惹かれるとはな。そいつがわしらの一番最近の犠牲者だ。
A New Beginning#338.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#339.src: It's a damn shame. A tragedy each 'n every time, yet still happens often enough to feel routine. But that's life, I reckon.
A New Beginning#339.dst: まったく惜しいことだ。毎回が悲劇なのに、慣れちまうほど頻繁に起きる。だが、それが人生ってもんだろう。
A New Beginning#339.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#340.src: ...did you now? Funny thing to say about a dead man, considering I ain't ever seen you 'round these parts before.
A New Beginning#340.dst: …ほう？死人についておかしなことを言うな。この辺でお前さんを見かけたことなんぞ一度もないのに。
A New Beginning#340.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#341.src: Now, spill. 'Fore I go and tell Synny you ain't no good after all.
A New Beginning#341.dst: さあ、吐け。やっぱりお前さんは駄目だと Synny に言いに行く前にな。
A New Beginning#341.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#342.src: Ah... caught Rex muttering something 'bout that once or twice before. Poor girl... it'd do her well to set it aside, for a time.
A New Beginning#342.dst: ああ… Rex がそのことを一、二度ぼやいとるのを聞いた。かわいそうに… しばらく脇に置いといたほうが、あの子のためだ。
A New Beginning#342.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#343.src: Didn't think much of it, but I suppose you're livin' proof, aren'tcha? Strange as can be...
A New Beginning#343.dst: 大して気にしとらんかったが、お前さんが生きた証拠ってわけか？まったく妙なもんだ…
A New Beginning#343.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#344.src: Say, is the memory wipin' a real thing? Got no damn clue where that theory started, but... well, if one thing's true, why not the rest?
A New Beginning#344.dst: なあ、記憶を消すってのは本当なのか？どこから出た説か見当もつかんが… まあ、一つが本当なら残りもそうだろう？
A New Beginning#344.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#345.src: Damn. Damn. That's rough. That real rough, ain't it. And you're tellin' me that's where he ended up?
A New Beginning#345.dst: くそ。くそっ。ひどい話だ。本当にひどい、そうだろう。で、あいつは最後にそこへ流れ着いたってのか？
A New Beginning#345.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#346.src: Hrm... y'know, it's funny. Big guy like him, you wouldn't take him for a thief. Hard to keep hidden, eh? And yet...
A New Beginning#346.dst: うーむ… なあ、おかしなもんだ。あんな大男、泥棒には見えん。隠れるのも難しいだろう？なのに…
A New Beginning#346.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#347.src: He'd manage to turn blending into a crowd into an art. No matter where he was, who he spoke to, how he was actin', he'd always seem like he fit right in.
A New Beginning#347.dst: あいつは人混みに紛れるのを芸術にしとった。どこにいようと、誰と話そうと、どう振る舞おうと、いつも自然に溶け込んどった。
A New Beginning#347.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#348.src: ...t'was a right stupid risk that did him in, in the end. I told him, I did it ain't worth breaking into the Sovereign's place, especially not during festival times...
A New Beginning#348.dst: …結局、あいつを殺したのは馬鹿げた無茶だった。言ったんだ、確かに言った。君主の屋敷に忍び込む価値はない、祭りの時期は特にな…
A New Beginning#348.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#349.src: But he was the kinda sort to dig in his heels. Said he'd be fine, said it'd be worth it, nabbin' all those documents. Something to help the cause... I hardly even remember now.
A New Beginning#349.dst: だが、あいつは言い出したら聞かん奴でな。大丈夫だ、やる価値はある、書類を全部かっさらうと。大義の役に立つ何か… 今じゃほとんど覚えとらん。
A New Beginning#349.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#350.src: Can't save 'em all. Especially not from themselves. I've learned that many times over, over my years.
A New Beginning#350.dst: 全員は救えん。特に、自分自身からはな。長年、何度も思い知らされた。
A New Beginning#350.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#351.src: So he got caught. Heard a cursed one got involved... was a whole damn mess. Sovereign really wasn't happy with Synny when he heard, let me tell you. Ain't seen her that shellshocked in years.
A New Beginning#351.dst: で、捕まった。呪われし者が絡んだと聞いた… ひどい有様だったそうだ。君主は聞いて Synny にえらくご立腹だった、本当に。あいつがあれほど呆然としとるのは何年ぶりか。
A New Beginning#351.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#352.src: ...but you're sayin' he lived? How's that all work out?
A New Beginning#352.dst: …だが、あいつは生きとったと？どういうことだ？
A New Beginning#352.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#353.dst: ああ。そうか。そう… か。
A New Beginning#353.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#354.src: Well... tell me this, then. Was he happy, you think? Out there in the wider world? Did he live a good life?
A New Beginning#354.dst: じゃあ… これだけ教えてくれ。あいつは幸せだったと思うか？外の広い世界で？いい人生を送ったか？
A New Beginning#354.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#355.src: ...alright. Alrighty. Good. That that's good, y'hear. I... I'm glad for that much.
A New Beginning#355.dst: …そうか。そうか。よかった。そりゃよかった。わしは… それだけで嬉しい。
A New Beginning#355.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#356.src: Thank you for... for tellin' me all that. S'not a tale that ends in happiness, but I reckon so long as he made the most of it... that's all you can really hope for.
A New Beginning#356.dst: 話してくれて… ありがとうよ。幸せに終わる話じゃないが、あいつが精一杯生きたなら… 望めるのはそれくらいだろう。
A New Beginning#356.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#357.src: Y'may as well leave me be a while, now. Got some thinkin' to get through.
A New Beginning#357.dst: しばらく一人にしてくれ。考えることがある。
A New Beginning#357.speaker: Kaio
